[doc-26#c0] The Zarrow Permafrost Site was instrumented in 1986 on a gently sloping terrace above the Zarrow river.

[doc-26#c1] Ground temperature is logged down a cased borehole, and the depth of summer thaw is probed along a fixed transect each September.

[doc-09#c1] Sensors are buried at a depth of three metres to reduce wind noise, and are linked by armoured cable to a central recording hut.
